source_observations: WatchEventWhenAutoResetTest.setUp lines 101-106 constructs QuorumUtil(1), starts three peers, and connects clients to peers 1 and 2.
WatchEventWhenAutoResetTest.testNodeDataChanged lines 131-136 creates through client 1, shuts peer 1 down, updates the znode through client 2, restarts peer 1, and waits for client 1 to reconnect.
QuorumUtil lines 100-106 sets ALL=2*N+1, so QuorumUtil(1) creates three peers; QuorumUtil.start lines 206-214 replaces and starts the peer with the same ID and data directory.
ZooKeeperServer.processConnectRequest guard compares the reconnecting client's lastZxidSeen to the server data tree's lastProcessedZxid; its exact compiled target is pinned in the healthy config.
qualification: The existing test has a write-before-reconnect state transition relevant to both zxid operands. Exact named zk1 guard reach, no selected throw, and same-occurrence pretarget door remain to be verified by a fresh healthy run. The previous readBool fault leaves both zxid operands unchanged and is not a basis for repeating a full fault budget.
